description: Combine two or more PDF files into one, in the order given. Saves next to the first file as name-merged.pdf unless output is set.

inputs.description: Paths of the PDF files, in order.

output.description: Where to save the result. Defaults to the first file's name with -merged, in the same folder.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Defaults to false.

name: pdf_merge
title: Merge PDFs
